## Purpose
Implements the Run History page: a searchable/filterable/sortable list of past runs grouped into revision families, and a detail view (opened either internally or, when `onOpenRun` is supplied, routed into the shared live run screen) that replays a completed run's deliverable, files, thinking trace, and audit log.

## Shape
- `WorkflowHistory(props)` — top-level component; fetches runs via `getWorkflows`, paginates with `handleLoadMore`, and branches its render between the list view and (when `selectedRun` is set) the detail view.
- `handleSelectRun` — routes a row click to one of three places: the live execution view if the run is currently active (`onViewRunningPipeline`), the shared run screen (`onOpenRun`) if provided, or the legacy internal detail view as a fallback.
- Detail-view type flags (`isUserStory`, `isPpt`, `isPrototype`, `isAppBuilder`, `isGeneric*`) — classify `selectedRun.type` plus, for unrecognized types, the persisted `deliverableMimetype` (via the shared `resolveReopenMimetype` helper) to pick the same renderer set `PreviewPanel` uses on the live path.
- `parseFilesForIDE` — the history-page's own copy of the ` ```filename:` code-block parser used to build the App Builder file tree for a reopened run (mirrors `PreviewPanel.parseAppBuilderFilesForIDE`).
- `cleanDisplayTitle` — strips polluted `===...===` context-block markers and `Title: ` prefixes from stored run titles, falling back to re-deriving a title from the raw run input.
- Revision-family plumbing (`groupRunsByFamily`, `family` state, `handleSelectVersion`) imported from `RevisionFamilyView`, used to group the list by root run and let the detail view switch between versions of the same family.
- `RunDetailPage` (imported) supplies the detail view's left-column summary (KPIs, per-agent breakdown, version timeline, failure banner) as the single source of truth, so this file owns only the right-column deliverable/files/thinking/audit tabs.

## Why this shape
The reopen (history) rendering logic is kept structurally identical to the live `PreviewPanel` path — same mimetype-driven dispatch, same `DegradedRunAffordance`-style failure gating, same SC-001 "never a workflow-name branch" rule — specifically to prevent the two surfaces (live vs. reopened) from drifting apart, per the file's own INV-3/SC-001 comments.
